instruction: Build an accessible Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl + K) for a Next.js App Router app using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, framer-motion and lucide-react. Requirements: a context provider that owns open/close state and a global keyboard shortcut; a glassmorphism dialog with a blurred backdrop and spring-like enter/exit animations that respect prefers-reduced-motion; the ARIA combobox/listbox pattern (aria-activedescendant, focus stays in the input); grouped results (Navigation, Actions, Theme) with ranked search (prefix, word-start, substring, keyword, fuzzy subsequence) and highlighted matches; ArrowUp/ArrowDown wrap-around navigation, Enter to run, Escape to close, IME-safe key handling, and active option scrolled into view; mouse hover that syncs with the keyboard cursor without fighting scroll; body scroll lock and focus restoration; an empty state; a live result count; a trigger button that shows the right shortcut hint per platform. Separate the command data, the search logic and the UI into clean modules.

Create a responsive Bento Grid features section for a Next.js App Router landing page using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Requirements: an async-free Server Component grid driven by a typed data module where each item declares its own Tailwind span classes (a large 2x2 analytics card, tall and wide variants, and small cards); a tiny client component that adds a cursor-following spotlight glow by writing CSS variables directly on the element (no React re-renders on pointer move); a distinct decorative visual per card (animated bar chart, pulsing edge-network nodes, security badges, integration icon tiles, chat bubbles with a typing indicator) that is hidden from assistive tech and uses motion-safe animation only; glassmorphism cards on a dark background with blurred gradient blobs; semantic article/heading structure; keyboard-visible focus styles; single-column mobile layout. Keep data, visuals, the spotlight card and the grid in separate files.

Build an interactive usage-based pricing calculator for Next.js (App Router) with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and framer-motion. Requirements: pure, unit-testable pricing logic in lib/pricing.ts (seat price, included requests, overage per 1,000 requests, seat caps per plan, yearly discount, best-value plan recommendation, Intl formatters); a reusable accessible RangeField built on a native input type=range with a gradient fill track, custom thumb styling for WebKit and Firefox, aria-valuetext, an output element and a hint; a logarithmic-style stepped requests slider; a billing toggle with aria-pressed and a Save 20% badge; plan cards implemented as native radio inputs (arrow-key navigation for free, disabled when the seat count exceeds the plan cap, peer-based focus and checked styles) with a Best value badge and a way to return to auto-selection; a sticky glassmorphism summary card with a spring-animated total (falling back to static text under prefers-reduced-motion), a line-item breakdown, and a polite live region for screen readers.

Create a production-ready animated site navigation for a Next.js App Router marketing site using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and framer-motion. Requirements: a fixed glass header that gains blur, border and shadow after scrolling, hides when scrolling down and reappears when scrolling up (via useScroll and useMotionValueEvent, disabled for reduced-motion users); a spring-smoothed scroll progress bar; desktop links with a shared-layout hover pill and a shared-layout active-route underline using layoutId and usePathname with aria-current; a morphing hamburger button (aria-expanded, aria-controls, dynamic aria-label); a mobile menu using AnimatePresence with animated height and staggered link entrance; Escape to close with focus returned to the toggle, body scroll lock while open, auto-close on route change and when the viewport grows to desktop size; a skip-to-content link; MotionConfig with reducedMotion set to user. Keep the link data separate from the component and show how to wire it into app/layout.tsx.

Build an interactive revenue analytics widget for a Next.js App Router dashboard using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and framer-motion. Requirements: an async Server Component page that loads data for 7D, 30D and 90D ranges from a data module (deterministic seeded mock data with UTC dates so server and client render identically); a client card with an accessible tablist (roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End, aria-controls to a tabpanel) and a shared-layout animated selection pill; a header that shows the range total with a period-over-period delta badge (colour and screen-reader text), and switches to the hovered day's value while scrubbing; a smooth SVG area/line chart built from a pure geometry helper using Catmull-Rom to Bezier smoothing, gradient fill and stroke, non-scaling strokes and a left-to-right clip-path reveal that replays on range change and respects prefers-reduced-motion; HTML overlays (crosshair, dot, edge-aware tooltip) positioned in percentages so nothing distorts when the SVG stretches; pointer scrubbing with touch-pan-y plus full keyboard scrubbing through a role=slider with aria-valuetext; y-axis grid labels, x-axis date labels, and average/best/lowest stats; empty and not-enough-data states; dark mode. Separate data, chart geometry/formatting, chart component, card and page.
